author: OpenClip Team

description.en: Quick add a new reminder task to Apple Reminders.
description.zh-Hans: 快速添加新提醒任务到提醒事项。
description.zh-Hant: 快速新增提醒事項至提醒事項。
description.ja: Apple リマインダーに新規タスクを素早く追加します。
description.fr: Ajoute rapidement un nouveau rappel dans Rappels Apple.

releaseNotes: Fixes the created reminder's ID being pasted into the frontmost app; adds a confirmation toast.

action.scriptCode:
tell application "Reminders"
	set defaultList to default list
	tell defaultList
		make new reminder with properties {name:OPENCLIP_TEXT}
	end tell
end tell
return ""
